2609.25939.title: ClusterFewshot: Improving Few-shot Optimization for LLMs workflow
2609.25939.paper_summary: The performance of large language model (LLM) workflows often depends on selecting a small set of in-context demonstrations to guide model behavior on new tasks. Recent methods improve this process by augmenting prompts with successful reasoning paths. However, their demonstration selection relies on random sampling or metric-based rankings, overlooking the semantic structure of the task. We propose ClusterFewshot, a strategy that combines semantic structuring with utility-aware scoring to construct representative and effective few-shot demonstration sets. Evaluated within DSPy-based pipelines, ClusterFewshot substantially reduces optimization cost across multiple benchmarks, while consistently improving accuracy relative to prior bootstrap-based methods in both standalone prompt tuning and hybrid prompt-weight optimization.
2609.25939.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）工作流程的效能通常取決於選擇一小組上下文示範來指導模型在新任務上的行為。最近的方法通過增強提示與成功的推理路徑來改善這一過程。然而，它們的示範選擇依賴於隨機抽樣或基於指標的排名，忽視了任務的語義結構。我們提出了ClusterFewshot，一種將語義結構與效用感知評分相結合的策略，以構建具有代表性和有效性的少量示範集。在基於DSPy的管道中進行評估時，ClusterFewshot顯著降低了多個基準的優化成本，同時在獨立提示調整和混合提示權重優化中，相對於先前的基於引導的方法，持續提高了準確性。
